Corporate Social Responsibility

A Legacy of Responsibility

Our mission extends beyond just crafting iconic buildings.

We are dedicated to shaping a better future for Bangalore by investing in the communities and environment that make it extraordinary. Our commitment to social responsibility and sustainable development is the foundation of our legacy, ensuring every project contributes to a thriving, vibrant city for generations to come.

Police Traffic Park : Where Education Meets Civic Sense

From 2003 onwards, Vaswani Group has taken up the development of the Traffic Park at the intersection of Saint Mark’s and Madras Bank Road (adjacent to Bowring Institute). The whole endeavour from “Concept to Completion” took just 100 days, and it was the privilege of Vaswani Group to take part in this unique, “first-of-its-kind” Public-Private initiative, wherein the developer has directly borne the cost of the entire infrastructure within the park.

Among other things, the Traffic Park involves several thoughtfully designed elements which add to its utility such as a gazebo, a 100 seater amphitheater for lectures on traffic safety, a children’s play area with play equipment, jogging trails, manicured lawns, innovative lighting, water body with “mist effect”, a bus bay to facilitate visits from school children. In short, the Traffic Park combines traffic education and recreational elements for residents of the nearby areas, tiny tots as well as office goers, in a truly unique way.

Urban Infrastructure : Road widening work in Whitefield

Vaswani Group is one of the organizations which took up the development activity involving widening the stretch of road beyond Marathahalli and leading to Whitefield into a four lane road, in yet another public-private participation initiative in collaboration with the Public Works Department (PWD). This commitment was specifically keeping in mind our various projects in and around this area, and hence our decision to take part in this road improvement activity was an offshoot of our commitment towards being a responsible corporate citizen.

Investing in Education : Adoption of Pattandur Village School

Vaswani Group is actively in the process of adopting the Pattandur Village School in the vicinity of our “Vaswani Pinnacle” project. The modalities are in the process of being worked out, and this would be of immense benefit to the several hundred students of this school. A proposal in this regard has already been prepared for doing the needful.

Greening Our City : Planting of Avenue Trees

The Vaswani Group is also considering planting of Avenue trees in the Mahadevapura area. A proposal has already been submitted to the CMC in this regard, and formal clearance is awaited.

Construction of Bellandur Gram Panchayat Office

This was one of the very first “social responsibility initiatives” undertaken by the Vaswani Group, wherein we undertook the concept, design and construction of the Bellandur Gram Panchayat office in the year 1994-1995. A water tank was also constructed by Vaswani Group to take care of the drinking water requirements of the children from the nearby school, as well as for the general public, directly opposite the Panchayat office.

Service road Asphalting on the Airport-Sarjapur Outer Ring Road

Vaswani Group has completed the asphalting of the entire stretch of service road opposite the country club and adjacent to the Eden Huts Dhaba, to facilitate the smooth movement of traffic.

Tsunami Relief : Donation to the Prime Minister’s Relief Fund

Vaswani Group had also expressed its solidarity with the victims of the tragic events caused by the tsunami and its aftermath, by making a sizeable contribution to the Honourable Prime Minister’s Relief Fund set up for the purpose.

Renovations at the Fire Station on Bannerghatta Road

Seeing that the flag post at the fire station located on the Bannerghatta Road was in a dilapidated condition, Vaswani Group undertook and completed the task of renovating the same, by laying the granite for the entire section.

Our Ongoing Commitment

We're continually looking for ways to innovate and contribute.

If you share our vision for a sustainable and equitable future, we invite you to explore partnership opportunities with us. We're keen to collaborate on new sustainable development initiatives and welcome partners to work with us on our social and educational community welfare programs.
